cards.title: At Point Shamrock
mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Shamrock Arrivals/PT Shamrock/PT Shamrock
instructions: Turn HDG 200° toward the High Bridge
cards.source: Binder, p. 68; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 110–111.

cards.title: Request the straight-in
cards.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Shamrock Arrivals/PT Shamrock/PT Shamrock
cards.leadIn: Terminate with Approach, then contact Tower:

exchange.speaker: Tower
exchange.text: <callsign>, Navy Corpus Tower, report initial RWY {to.runway}.

cards.title: Cleared for the straight-in
instructions: Descend and level off at 500 ft MSL
Gear down, flaps as required, Before Landing checklist
cards.source: Binder, p. 68; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slide 110.

exchange.speaker: Tower
exchange.text: <callsign>, Navy Corpus Tower, roger, report right base RWY {to.runway}.

cards.title: Right base, gear down
cards.leadIn: From Point Dimmit, turn to intercept the extended centerline, then descend to the runway:

radio.script: “Navy Corpus Tower, <callsign>, right base gear down.”

cards.source: Binder, p. 68; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slide 110.
